usageNotes: Use this endpoint to fetch a prerendered RRD performance graph (returned as a PNG filename path) for a specific LXC container. The caller must specify at least one datasource (e.g., `cpu`, `mem`, `netin`, `netout`, `diskread`, `diskwrite`) and a timeframe; the node must be online and the container must exist. The response returns a `filename` pointing to the generated PNG on the Proxmox host, not the raw image bytes — use the file path to retrieve the image separately if needed.

examples.summary: Get a 24-hour CPU and memory usage graph for LXC container 101 on node pve1

tips: Common datasource names for LXC containers: cpu, mem, netin, netout, diskread, diskwrite — these match the names shown in the Proxmox web UI graphs.
The `cf` parameter defaults to AVERAGE when omitted; use MAX to see peak spikes rather than averaged values.

The returned `filename` is a server-side path to the PNG; you cannot download it directly from this endpoint — pair it with a file fetch or use rrddata endpoint if you need raw data points instead of an image.
Use `get_nodes_node_lxc_vmid_rrddata` instead if you need numeric time-series data rather than a rendered graph.
